en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a landscaped park with a fountain in the middle and well-maintained lawns, surrounded by tall trees. The Swedish text at the bottom of the image says 'Parti af parken vid Råbäck' and 'Hotell Kinnekulle.' On the reverse, there is an address written in cursive, a green Swedish postage stamp with a portrait, and preprinted Swedish instructions.
